notes.title: Rework Update!
notes.notes:
Hello,

This game has been out for 2 years now.

During that time I have been reading feedback and watching playthroughs. I've seen what needs to be fixed and shortly after release started seeing an issue where certain levels just wouldn't work on certain peoples computers and no matter what I changed it wouldn't resolve the issue.

So I decided to switch game engines to a way better one. And now There are many new possibilities of the original ideas for the game that were unachievable at the time with the engine I was using.

Now for the future of the game. It will be getting some random and some scheduled updates through out the days leading up to Jan 17th where it will make its main branch re-release. Look forward to the familiar locations completely redone and many...MANY new areas. 

Good luck finding them all          .    .  
                                                     =

If you would like to test any new updates please check your branches and set it to PRERELEASE the first test-update will be out Tomorrow!
